judgments.question: Are the implementation services distinct from the hosted SaaS subscription under ASC 606-10-25-19 through 25-21?
judgments.proposedConclusion: Distinct. The implementation services are routine configuration, data migration, and training; the hosted service is a standard offering that is not materially modified, and other vendors could perform comparable implementation work.
judgments.basis: MSA Section 3 describes implementation as standard configuration and training against an unmodified hosted service; the price book shows observable standalone sales of the implementation package.

alternatives.conclusion: Not distinct; combine with the SaaS subscription
alternatives.notes: Would apply if the implementation significantly customizes or integrates the hosted service. Combined treatment would recognize the implementation allocation over the subscription term.
